account: This node produces the essay's working account of kitsch and the analytical bridge to AI art, in one bounded reasoning pass drawing only on general cultural knowledge (no sources exist in the dossier). It is not a survey and not drafting prose; it locks the conceptual deliverables the parent "root" node needs to carry a defended thesis: (1) a plain-language 100-150 word characterization of kitsch built from its recognizable features (pre-digested emotion, formulaic beauty, instant legibility, comfort without risk, sentimentality, repetition of exhausted conventions), (2) a feature-by-feature verdict on AI-generated art's fit — at least four features — marking those that fit AI output "nearly by design" (e.g., formulaic beauty and instant legibility, since diffusion models optimize toward statistically familiar, immediately legible images; and comfort-without-risk, since prompting for safe beauty is cheap) against those that fit poorly (notably the dependence of kitsch on a sincere sentimental author, which AI output lacks), and (3) a statement of the single hardest conceptual tension the essay must face: whether something can count as kitsch without a sincere human author behind it, i.e., whether kitsch is a property of the object or of an authorial stance. These three deliverables map one-to-one onto the acceptance_condition, so acceptance is mechanical.

decidability.account: All needed context is fixed in the dossier: audience (general educated reader), register (standalone cultural criticism), stance (argued, nuanced thesis; no neutral survey), form (plain prose, no citations/theorists), and the explicit note that no source materials exist — this is reasoning from general cultural knowledge, so no further evidence is needed. Acceptance is fully mechanical: a 100-150 word kitsch characterization, a verdict on at least four features relative to AI art, and one named hardest tension all have countable, verifiable forms. The node's product (working definition + analytical bridge) feeds only the parent 'root' finalizer, not any sibling's future output, so it is independent of sibling nodes.
grounded_referents: recognizable kitsch features: pre-digested emotion, formulaic beauty, instant legibility, comfort without risk, sentimentality, repetition of exhausted conventions
mechanics of AI-generated art: statistical imitation of familiar training distributions on text prompt
acceptance_condition deliverables: 100-150 word characterization, ≥4 feature verdicts, one hardest tension
